cards.title: A new look
cards.body: Glass controls that bend what is behind them, a calmer player, and the Inter typeface throughout.

cards.title: Encore
cards.body: Your listening by day, week, month and year, with charts and stories. It lives in Library.

cards.title: Equalizer
cards.body: Shape the sound with a tone pad or ten bands, before it reaches the phone.

cards.title: Cars, speakers and TVs
cards.body: Riff in Android Auto, and on Chromecasts and Google speakers from the output button under the player.

cards.title: Smart crossfade
cards.body: Downloaded songs blend where they wind down, on the beat when both have one. Turn it on in Settings, Playback.
